title: If the land sins — Noah, Daniel, Job
english: [[If a land sins >> Bible:Ezekiel 14:13]], famine strikes the land itself. Even [[Noah, Daniel, and Job >> Bible:Ezekiel 14:14]] would deliver only their own souls — not a corrupt city’s crowd.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Attend the hard spectacle of judgment
english: Lean in: the land’s judgment is a hard spectacle for the mind. Glory to God. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).
